Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
The Scying secrets card says useable against a meth. you've bled...

A meth. bleeds me. I announce "I don't block. How much? For one?" He
says yes, but he says he plays scyring secrets. I say "Well I'm
soaking it. Banner of Nuetrality.". He says, "Hey! That's not fair! Do
I get to play my scying secrets or not? I want to look at your
library!" I say "Your bleed didn't resolve, you jumped the gun on
playing scying secrets"...

Its confusing...

Please help with this situation.

~SV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Scrying of Secrets is playable in the same way as superior Spying Mission.

Timing windows for effects in this situation:

1) As announced
2) Stuff until the "I don't block" decision
3) Stuff after 2) but before the action resolution
4) Stuff played during action resolution

SoS (and superior SM) are played in #4.
BoN is played in #3.

The Methuselah wanting to play SoS should wait for the target to
move his/her pool to the blood bank (indicating no further reactions)
before playing the SoS.
